evaluation_criteria.details: No conflicting primary evidence encountered. Census 2011, LGD directory, and official government portals are mutually consistent.
geoBoundaries gbOpen ADM2 is confirmed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Attribution obligations are clearly documented.
Zero route geometries are proposed for canonical promotion in Stage F. All candidate corridor geometries remain strictly in staging.
Survey of India OMP click-through requirements are recognized, and geoBoundaries open data was selected and validated under CC BY 4.0.
Physical ground access evidence is unanimous: outer paved areas and ramps are accessible; ancient sanctum sanctorums (Garbhagriha) are physically and ritually restricted.

escalation_summary: No disputes or ambiguities met the threshold for external Codex CLI invocation during Stage F.
